name: Code block
summary: A piece of code with its file name and language, a Copy button, and long lines that scroll sideways inside the box.
use: to show a command, a snippet or an example request the person can copy
states: selected when the clipboard is blocked
a11y: The code box is a named region that Tab reaches, so keyboard users can scroll it with the arrow keys; the Copy button says Copied when it worked.

use_when: the answer includes a command, a config file, a snippet or an example request the person will run or paste
avoid_when: a short command name inside a sentence: keep it in the text
a file the person downloads: use file-card
a form the person fills in: use a form part

parts.name: filename
parts.what: the file the code belongs in

parts.name: language
parts.what: the language or tool, in words

parts.name: copy
parts.what: copies the code to the clipboard, or selects it when the page may not use the clipboard

parts.name: code
parts.what: the code itself, as plain text

empty.how: with no code, answer in plain text instead of this part

loading.how: the renderer shows muted blocks for the names and the code

error.how: when the clipboard is blocked, the code is selected and the button says Selected

disabled.how: an answer without a copy action shows no button

overflow.how: long lines and tall code scroll inside the code box, never the page

long_text.how: code keeps its lines and scrolls sideways; a long file name wraps

keyboard: Tab reaches Copy, then the code box
arrow keys scroll the focused code box
